g.text: Detailed Post-InterPro Evidence and Boundary Pipeline

text.tspan: Scientific guardrail: the register copies intervals, relations and classifications from the core source tables; it does not recompute them. Before cluster annotation,
the same run-local register contains exon-protein intervals and marks domain-dependent evidence pending_cluster; post-cluster execution replaces that phase view.
source database + accession + entry type + interval
optional overlay, not a domain edge
pyTMHMM helices in a separate lane
retain native position and matched interval
identity + distance + class + policy + QC reason
source file + source row; run reports + post-cluster QC
SHA-256 for every available source artifact
map observations across species and MSA columns
counts, matrices, paired values and review cases
summary, distance plots and detail track
matrix, paired plot, outliers and inspection cases
shared semantic specification -> SVG / PDF / PNG
exact | near <= 5 aa | inside | outside | unavailable
aligned | near | within | between | review / missing
